tldr: Consolidated revenue up 34% YoY to Rs. 96,000 Cr.
India volumes hit record 2 lakh units; EV share 43%.
JLR faces China decline but strong UK and core brand growth.
management_commentary: Commodity costs elevated in Q3, plateauing in Q4.
EV demand significantly exceeds supply, causing low inventory.
JLR resetting breakeven volumes to 300,000 units.
guidance: Net debt to close FY27 around Rs. 47,000 Cr.
JLR FY27 EBIT expected in 2-3% range.
Domestic capex to be 6-7% of revenue in FY27.

segment_performance.notes: Record volumes, 14.3% market share, strong EV leadership.
China down 30%, UK strong, core brands growing.

notable_qa.question: China brand disruption risk?
notable_qa.answer: Yes, but luxury brands must stay contemporary.

risks: China market decline and competitive pressure.
JLR cash outflows from high investments.
